name: Coffin of Doll ~Tasogare no Megami~
source:
"Run away, doll. Run to the imperial capital."
These words are all she can remember. Although she lost her memory, the girl departs for the capital. On her journey, she meets new people, who also want to get there.
Three hundred years have passed since the events of [url=https://vndb.org/v43910]Kanaderu wa Rasen no Shirabe[/url]. The gears have started turning once again.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22950]Freem![/url]]
translation:
“逃吧，娃娃。逃到帝都去。”
她只记得这些话。虽然失去了记忆，少女还是启程前往京城。在旅途中，她遇到了同样想要到达那里的新朋友。
自 [url=https://vndb.org/v43910]Kanaderu wa Rasen no Shirabe[/url] 事件以来，已经过去了三百年。齿轮再次开始转动。

[译自[url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/22950]Freem![/url]]
